name: Sprouted Moong Salad
ingredients: 100 g firm tofu or paneer, cubed
½ tsp chaat masala and a pinch of black salt
steps: Steam the sprouts for 4–5 minutes and cool.
Combine with the cucumber, tomato, onion and coriander.
Add the tofu or paneer and pomegranate.
Dress with lemon juice, chaat masala, black salt and chilli.
note: Light, high in fibre and protein, and low in fat.
